Name: Measures should have a format string
Description: Visible measures with no format string render as raw numbers in Q&A and Excel.

Name: Measure has empty DAX expression
Description: Measures with empty / BLANK() DAX have no business logic; they ship as analyst-fix-this placeholders.

Name: Measures should live in a display folder
Description: Measures without DisplayFolder pile up at the table root and clutter the field list. Group them by topic.

Name: Foreign-key columns should be hidden
Description: FK columns (used in relationships) shouldn't appear in the field list — analysts pick them by mistake instead of the dim's name column.
Expression: Model.Relationships.Any(it.FromColumn == outerIt or it.ToColumn == outerIt) and IsHidden == false and IsKey == false

Name: Avoid bi-directional relationships
Description: Bi-directional cross-filter relationships cause ambiguity and slow query plans. Use single-direction wherever possible.

Name: DAX should use DIVIDE() not /
Description: Bare `/` returns #INF on zero-denominator; DIVIDE(num, denom, 0) gives a safe fallback.

Name: Hidden columns shouldn't have IsKey set on a visible relationship endpoint
Description: Catches the inverse of COLUMNS_HIDE_FK — a hidden column that's also marked as a relationship key (usually fine, but worth a glance).
Expression: IsHidden and IsKey and Model.Relationships.Any(it.FromColumn == outerIt or it.ToColumn == outerIt) == false
